company_profile: Veo builds AI-powered sports cameras and analysis software that track every player and the ball, giving clubs and youth players match footage, data and analytics.
title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Senior Machine Learning Engineer with 8+ years delivering real-world ML systems from concept to deployment across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Trains and ships deep learning, classical ML and LLM models, and builds evaluation schemes that show where models perform well and where they fall short. Writes maintainable production software with PyTorch, FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes and MLflow, and shares knowledge across teams. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Match Event Detection Pipeline
bullets: Built an event detection model for football tracking data, training a PyTorch LSTM on player and ball position sequences to flag key match moments such as shots and runs.
Evaluated per-event precision and recall with error analysis on missed moments, and served the model through a FastAPI inference pipeline in Docker with experiments tracked in MLflow.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Machine Learning Engineer role in Veo's AI team. Over 8+ years I have taken machine learning systems from a first idea to production, and learned that the work is only finished when you understand where a model fails. Building models that people can trust is the thread through my career.

Veo turns a single camera on any pitch into evidence about every player, and the idea that a young player no longer depends on someone happening to notice them really speaks to me. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Copenhagen together and settle there long term.

I would bring end-to-end ownership and careful evaluation. At Viavi I took an SLA breach prediction system into production with LightGBM, FastAPI and MLflow, reducing downtime by 67%. At United Health Group I built evaluation pipelines with tracing and failure detection that cut human review by 43%, the same habit I would bring to your models.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It has taught me to build for real users and to check results with care before calling anything done. I would be glad to talk about how I could contribute to the AI team.
